title: SemCred-FL: LLM-Guided Dual-View Credibility Aggregation for Robust Federated Intrusion Detection under Data Poisoning
description: Research implementation of SemCred-FL, a federated intrusion-detection aggregation method that combines offline semantic evidence with numerical update evidence, persistent trust, eligibility filtering, and clipping.
